journey.name: activity tag input is capped at 20 characters
journey.description:
Verifies the Add Tag input on an activity stops accepting characters at 20, still allows deleting and retyping at the cap, and that the added tag renders as a one-line chip with its close icon visible. Line-break stripping cannot be driven from adb (no clipboard on the emulator image, and the field is single-line), so it is covered by TagsViewModelTest.kt instead.
Precondition: onboarded dev wallet with at least one activity item on the home screen. Type the tag in 8-character chunks, since `adb shell input text` drops characters on long strings; the exact characters that land do not matter, only the length. Start on the wallet home screen. Clean up afterwards: remove the tag from the activity, then delete it under Settings ▸ General ▸ Tags (testTag "TagsSettings", a row that only appears once a tag has been used), which keeps previously used tags separately.

actions.action: Tap the first activity item on the home screen (testTag "ActivityShort-0")
Verify the Add Tag sheet is visible with an empty new-tag input (testTag "TagInput")
Type "capped12", then "34567890", then "abcdefgh", then "ijklmnop" as four separate text inputs
Verify the new-tag input (testTag "TagInput") holds exactly 20 characters
Tap the keyboard delete key once (`adb shell input keyevent 67`)
Verify the new-tag input (testTag "TagInput") holds 19 characters
Verify the new-tag input (testTag "TagInput") holds exactly 20 characters and ends with "z"
Verify the activity detail tag row (testTag "ActivityTags") shows a chip whose testTag is "Tag-" followed by the 20-character input
Verify in a screenshot that the chip is a single line and its close icon (testTag "Tag-<tag>-delete") is fully visible inside the chip border
Tap the tag chip to remove it
Verify no tag chip remains on the activity detail
